arm_note: pack=True fills each needle row with as many examples as fit; pack=False leaves the single example padded to the training width, which is what the first probe ran and what made the four answer bytes 0.098 % of the gradient. These are the two arms of the packing comparison and they differ in this term alone.
design: the needle FORMAT is taught at short filler; the evaluation uses fillers never seen, so what has to generalise is the DISTANCE - the U1 shape (trained at 128, tested to 4096) in language. Training and evaluation key alphabets are disjoint, so no evaluation key can be memorised.
role: development probe: sizes the training budget, never used as evidence about the gate
